timing_statistic: Median of three complete passes, amortized per patient.
method_order: First measured pass uses listed order; second reverses it; third rotates by six methods.
excluded: diagnostic copies and validation replay checks
baseline_execution: Native implementations and decoding with their selected trained weights; MetaDrug includes UF.
evidrug_execution: Registered exact serving implementation; only immutable training-case representations are precomputed.
historical_replay_availability: Compare stored GPU probabilities where available; legacy SICdb validation probability files were not saved. Same-CPU repeated predictions and selected-checkpoint verification apply to all 39 pipelines.
historical_decoder_diagnostic: COGNet native decoding is checked for same-CPU repeat agreement; stored GPU scores are diagnostic.
